Chapter 8. The Counterattack—How Power Pushes Back
Change—even the smallest kind—hardly ever goes unchallenged.
You know that feeling right after a big win, when there’s relief, maybe even a little celebration?
But soon enough, resistance starts to show. Suddenly, the landlord finds new ways to bump up the rent. The company brings in consultants to try and break the union. Politicians who once seemed so supportive? They start hedging their words.
For anyone who’s just tasted victory, this pushback can hit like a punch to the gut.
Most folks don’t see it coming.
They imagine, once you’ve done the hard work and righted a wrong, the story wraps up nicely.
But anyone who’s been through this kind of struggle knows—that’s just not how power works.
Power doesn’t surrender quietly. It adapts, comes up with new strategies, and tries to divide or wear people down. Sometimes it hides behind the law. Sometimes it steers the media. Other times, it just waits for people to get tired and drift away.
This is when a movement really gets put to the test.
Some folks might feel discouraged and step back. But others? They dig in even deeper. They start to see the counterattacks coming and learn how to support each other, even when things get tough.
That’s when it becomes crystal clear—fighting for justice isn’t a quick sprint. It’s a marathon.
Every victory has to be defended, and fresh strategies are always needed.
For those who stick with it, the experience is exhausting—sure—but it’s also seriously empowering.
Setbacks don’t mean the end.
They become part of the journey. People discover strength they never knew they had.
And maybe the biggest lesson? The struggle isn’t just about winning or losing a single fight. It’s about building the ability to keep going, no matter what gets thrown your way.
So as the movement regroups, there’s a new sense of realism, but also a real spark of hope.
Sure, the forces of power are strong. But so is the determination of everyone who refuses to give up.
The story isn’t over—it’s really just the start of another chapter.
